feeds.title: Churchills Australian Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Churchills Australian Labradoodle's is a place where you can share posts, stay updated and chat with other Australian Labradoodle' families. We are breeders of Multi-generational Australian Labradoodles. Visit our website to know more about our dogs and puppies.

feeds.title: Cherry Valley Australian Labradoodles
feeds.description: We at Cherry Valley Australian Labradoodles are a family who raises Australian labradoodles. Fifteen years ago, I was looking for another dog. Loved the shaggy look and we heard about the Australian labradoodle from the relatives in Australia. Since then, Cherry Valley Labradoodles has been raising Australian Labradoodles exclusively since 2004.

feeds.title: Northbound Australian Labradoodles Ltd Blog
feeds.description: Northbound Australian Labradoodles Ltd is breeding with honesty and integrity. My dogs originate from established and recognised Australian Labradoodle lines. I breed for temperament and health, whilst staying true to the breed standard and its future development. I am exceptionally proud of my dogs and the wonderful puppies they produce, plus their owners whom I consider my friends.

feeds.title: Patriot's Day Doodles
feeds.description: Get the most recent news about the pups at Patriot's Day Doodles. Our mission is to be an ethical and reputable breeder of genuine Multi-generational Australian Labradoodles. We are committed to promoting this great breed by maintaining their unique level of health testing, distinct history and family oriented temperament.

feeds.title: Amalie Labradoodles
feeds.description: .Welcome to Amalie Labradoodles, an outstanding, accredited breeding program located on the Bellarine Peninsula (Victoria) and Byron Bay region (NSW), Australia. We specialise in beautiful, multi-generation Australian Labradoodles with exceptional temperament and health attributes. Visit our blog for our labradoodle news and helpful tips.

feeds.title: HeartRock Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to HeartRock Labradoodles located in the beautiful hill country on the outskirts of Austin, Texas. We are a small in-home breeder of authentic Australian Multi-Generational Labradoodles. We prioritize health, temperament, and conformation. Check out our blog for useful tips and information on caring for a pet Australian labradoodle.

feeds.title: Canadoodle Australian Labradoodles
feeds.description: Welcome to Canadoodle Australian Labradoodles where the first Multigeneration Australian Labradoodles were born in North America. We breed happy, healthy, home raised, quality, Australian Labradoodles! Visit our website to learn how to invite a loving labradoodle into your family!

feeds.title: Bedrock Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Meet our puppies and get to know when news pups will arrive with the Bedrock Labradoodles Blog. At Bedrock Labradoodles, our goal is to breed high quality Australian Labradoodle puppies and to place them in loving forever homes making everyone involved in the process exceedingly happy.

feeds.title: Valley Vineyard Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: The Valley Vineyard Labradoodles Blog tells you about our dogs and their pups. Get to know about the puppies and their forever homes. Our mission is to be an ethical, genuine Australian Labradoodle breeder in good standing while promoting this great breed by maintaining their health status, unique nature, temperament and characteristics.

feeds.title: Adorable Labradoodle Blog
feeds.description: Find out interesting information about the Australian Labradoodle with the Adorable Labradoodle Blog. We are a family of 6 musicians who have so much fun raising the animals. We were discovered our first Australian Labradoodle, not long after we had our first dog a Border Collie. We fell totally in love with these happy, loving dogs. We knew we just had to share this gift with other families.

feeds.title: Colonial Village Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: We are Indiana's most reputable labradoodle breeder. We are blessed to breed miniature labradoodle puppies, medium labradoodle puppies, and standard labradoodle puppies on our small family farm in scenic and rural Zionsville, Indiana, and we are proud to have our Australian Multi-Generational labradoodle puppies residing in all areas of the United States and in Canada!

feeds.title: Pride and Prejudoodles Blog
feeds.description: Families looking for a Doodle for sale can't go wrong with Pride & Prejudoodles. Your new family member will arrive ready to join the household with minimal effort on your part. Doodles from our heart to your health tested non-shedding hypoallergenic Goldendoodles and Labradoodles. Visit our blog to read all the latest care, grooming, and breed news from our farm.

feeds.title: Raggy Dogs Blog
feeds.description: The Raggy Dog Blog is here to educate, inspire and support people that are interested in knowing about the Australian Labradoodle. Tresilla Hellman, BPharm (Hons) has made a life-long commitment to helping people in their search to find and cultivate the best family dog for their lifestyle.

feeds.title: Log Cabin Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Check out the blogs featured here at Log Cabin Labradoodles in Dover-Foxcroft, ME, to understand breeding Australian Labradoodles. At Log Cabin Labradoodles, we are more than simply Australian Labradoodle breeders, and we are people who want our puppies to go to safe, happy, and healthy homes.

feeds.title: Cedar Bend Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: The Cedar Bend Labradoodles Blog tells you about us, our Authentic, multi-generational Australian Labradoodles, and much more. Cedar Bend Labradoodles is owned and operated by Andrew and Whitney Chardoulias. We live on a 4.5 acre farm in Cedar Falls, Iowa with chickens, horses, cats, and of course, our dogs. Our puppies are raised in our 1,000 sq. ft. puppy nursery, that is attached to our house.

feeds.title: Texas Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Visit the Texas Labradoodle Blog to know about our labradoodles and read the guide before you bring home a labradoodle. Our expert Australian Labradoodle Breeders breed healthy, well-socialized, smart, and friendly dogs as our priority. Labradoodle Breeders Texas ensures that they are breeding the healthiest dogs possible.

feeds.title: ​Texas Australian Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Looking for information on non allergenic puppies or Labradoodle dog breeds? Check out our blog to get everything you need to know. Texas Australian Labradoodles are credentialed Australian Labradoodle and Sheepadoodle breeder that breeds healthy, happy, and genetically stable TRUE Multigenerational Australian Labradoodle and Sheepadoodle puppies

feeds.title: Autumn Harvest Dood Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Get to know about Labradoodles, how to care for them and more with the Autumn Harvest Dood Ranch Blog. Autumn Harvest Dood Ranch is located in the beautiful Valley of Azalea, Oregon. We started this journey with a strong desire to enrich peoples lives through the wondrous breed of the Multi-Gen Australian Labradoodle.

feeds.title: Golden Gate Labradoodles
feeds.description: The Golden Gate Labradoodles blog brings you description and photos of the lives of our pups. Visit the Golden Gate Labradoodles website to get to know our puppies and their parents.

feeds.title: The Australian Labradoodle Association of America
feeds.description: Read the latest news about labradoodles from ALAA. The Australian Labradoodle Association of America (ALAA) protects the welfare of the Labradoodle and Australian Labradoodle breeds. The organization promotes responsible dog companionship by cataloging helpful information about the breeds and by offering networking services to breeders and owners.

feeds.title: Pococreek Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Get useful resources on Australian Labradoodles from the Pococreek Labradoodles Blog. Chimaki came to us full of life and fun and Shu-Shu arrived shortly thereafter. They launched us into our new enterprise as breeders of authentic Australian, Multi-Generational Labradoodles. PocoCreek Labradoodles is located in Southern California.

feeds.title: We Love Doodles Blog
feeds.description: Check out our latest posts and read the guides for various dog breeds. We're We Love Doodles. We are a website that is dedicated to dogs - especially Doodles! Whether you have a dog, are looking to rescue or purchase a puppy, or want to learn more about Doodles, we are here to help.

feeds.title: Kerry's Labradoodles of Seattle, LLC Blog
feeds.description: Come along on our Doodle journey with us! We share blog posts about what our puppies are up to and our plans for future litters. Check back frequently for updates. I'm Kerry and I'm passionate about raising and delivering beautiful, socialized, healthy, lifetime furry best friends. The pups are raised in our home, in the middle of our family space - this means constant socialization, stimulation, training, and love.

feeds.title: Highlands Australian Cobberdogs Blog
feeds.description: Here you can read Australian Cobberdog Puppies Updates. Highlands Australian Labradoodles is Colorado's premier Cobberdog Breeder of Australian Labradoodle puppies. We breed miniature and medium puppies from Australian Cobberdog lines directly descending from the original breed founders and developers in Australia, Rutland Manor and Tegan Park Breeding and Research Centers.

feeds.title: Arrowhead Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Read the Latest from Arrowhead about Australian Labradoodles and more. Get useful resources and all the information you need about caring for your new pup. Arrowhead is your only source for our unique blend of Australian Labradoodle/Cobberdog with the Wheaten Infusion.

feeds.title: Labradoodles.co.uk Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the doodleDogs Blog! Here, we've got articles explaining the differences between Labradoodles, our training programme and general updates about our puppies. We love sharing follow-up stories about our dogs - each one goes on to live very different and exciting lives across the world. We are the first Breeder to import ASD Australian Labradoodles into the UK in 2003.

feeds.title: Notch Hill Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Notch Hill Labradoodles are Certified Australian Labradoodle breeders, Notch Hill Labradoodles is Vancouver BC's premier breeder of labradoodle puppies. We are family-owned and operated. Read tips and information about us and Labradoodles here.

feeds.title: Great Day Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Find answers to your questions at the Great Day Labradoodle blog. More questions answered every month. Great Day Labradoodles is a home business in Salem, Oregon that breeds Australian Labradoodles. Our breeding goal is excellent health, temperament and conformation.

feeds.title: Ever After Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Get to know how to take care of your new Labradoodle puppy and get to know more about Labradoodles with our blog. Ever After Labradoodles are Reputable breeder of Australian Labradoodles.

feeds.title: Adirondack Doodles Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Adirondack Doodles Blog to get advice on Labradoodle care and other useful information. Adirondack Labradoodles, Goldendoodles, and Mini Goldendoodles are pets that are going to be around for the long haul! As responsible NY breeders, we provide home-raised, well socialized, healthy doodle puppies one litter at a time.

feeds.title: Brightstar Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Find out about adopting a labradoodle puppy, how big does a labradoodle gets? how much labradoodle cost? how to train your labradoodle and much more. Brightstar Labradoodles are a small, in-home breeder of Labradoodles. We raise our dogs at home where they are free to play with our children. Our Labradoodles are all living in the comforts of our home and are an indispensable part of our family.

feeds.title: Adorable Down East Labradoodles Blog
feeds.description: Get to know about the labradoodle puppies at Adorable Down East Labradoodles. Gerry of Adorable Down East Labradoodles (ADEL) has been breeding mini and medium labradoodles since 2005. After falling in love with the breed because of his first doodle, a chocolate café labradoodle by the name of Tully, Gerry was inspired to help bring more mini labradoodle love into the world.

feeds.title: Acme Creek Labradoodels Blog
feeds.description: Acme Creek Labradoodles blog is where you can read about the labradoodle puppies available. We have been breeding dogs for 33 years and breeding labradoodles for 19 years. We also breed occasional litter of Moyen poodles. I (Carol) have a degree as licensed veterinary technician which allows me to bring my medical knowledge into the breeding program.

feeds.title: Siess Ranch Mini Labradoodle Puppies Blog
feeds.description: Get to know our Miniature Labradoodle Puppies with our blog. Siess Ranch Mini Labradoodle Puppies is located outside of Seneca Kansas on our family farm. Our mini labradoodles enjoy running around and playing with our children and the grandchildren. The best part of raising these little gems is we get to be part of their lives from the start.
